scope: capability responsibilities and language-neutral I/O semantics; no implementation

capabilities.name: CameraAdapter
capabilities.responsibility: open and close a camera session and request a capture

capabilities.name: FrameAdapter
capabilities.responsibility: provide a bounded frame stream to local perception

capabilities.name: AlbumAdapter
capabilities.responsibility: save an accepted asset to a user-visible album

capabilities.name: ShareAdapter
capabilities.responsibility: share an accepted product asset through the current platform

capabilities.name: AuthAdapter
capabilities.responsibility: obtain a platform-neutral authenticated subject assertion

capabilities.name: StorageAdapter
capabilities.responsibility: store and retrieve assets by stable storage reference

capabilities.name: NetworkAdapter
capabilities.responsibility: report connectivity and perform authorized transport operations
